title: Habitat Hop A-Z
hook: One animal can use more than one kind of home.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool animal-habitat storybook, clear mini-biomes, friendly creatures, uncluttered educational composition

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child sorting habitat cards while allowing ecological overlap
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written habitat fit and range; overlaps explicit
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: habitat cue -> recall beat -> target -> card-sort gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a small habitat bell change plus muted drum footprint after the word.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a small habitat bell change plus muted drum footprint after the word
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Habitat Hop A-Z a habitat-fit matrix: forest, open grassland, desert, wetland, mountain, marine/ice and freshwater are compared, including animals that use multiple habitats.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child places animals into habitat columns but allows overlap; one animal can span more than one box.
